sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Italian Range Art." Specialty tier. Lofra makes Italian ranges with classic European styling. Available through Tasco in Canada. Hand-assembled in Italy with attention to traditional craftsmanship.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Italian kitchen aesthetics. Tasco dealer customers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Lofra:

• Hand-assembled in Italy

• Classic European styling

• Tasco distribution in Canada

• Traditional Italian craftsmanship

• Accessible Italian range pricing
